title: Magical No Bake Butter Beer Frozen Pie Dessert
description: A frozen, no-bake pie inspired by butterbeer, made with butterscotch pudding, cream soda, and whipped topping in a graham cracker crust.

ingredients.item: cream soda (Dr. Pepper Cream Soda Zero recommended)

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine the instant butterscotch pudding, cream soda, whole milk, and butterscotch extract.
Whisk the mixture for a couple of minutes until it starts to thicken.
Fold in the thawed whipped topping until beautifully combined.
Pour the mixture into the graham cracker pie crust.
Cover the pie and place it in the freezer for at least half a day or overnight.
When ready to serve, garnish with whipped cream and butterscotch drizzle.
notes:
The author suggests using Dr. Pepper Cream Soda Zero for the recipe. Ensure the pie is frozen for at least half a day for the best consistency.
